description: This plot illustrates the relationship between the ratio and minADE20 for different methods, including TrajICL, Head Tuning, FT, LoRA 16, and LoRA 64. The x-axis represents the ratio, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, and tick labels at intervals of 0.2. The y-axis represents minADE20, also with a linear scale, ranging from approximately 0.58 to 0.80. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different method: TrajICL (blue, solid line, circle markers), which starts at around 0.61 and remains relatively steady, ending at approximately 0.60; Head Tuning (orange, solid line, circle markers), which begins at around 0.80 and decreases to about 0.72; FT (green, solid line, circle markers), starting at approximately 0.68, decreasing to around 0.52; LoRA 16 (red, solid line, circle markers), beginning at about 0.76 and decreasing to approximately 0.60; and LoRA 64 (purple, solid line, circle markers), starting at around 0.76 and decreasing to about 0.60. All lines exhibit a generally decreasing trend as the ratio increases, with varying rates of decline.
